name: AI Calculators and Interactive Decision Tools
blurb: Six interactive estimators for the questions that decide whether an AI project is viable: token cost, GPU memory, context window fit, training cost, energy and carbon, and return on investment. Each shows its own arithmetic and states what it excludes.

reading.body:
Six interactive estimators cover the questions that decide whether an AI project is viable: token cost, GPU memory, context window fit, training cost, energy and carbon, and return on investment.

The set groups the operational constraints of AI into one place. Token cost and context window fit are software-level limits, while GPU memory and training cost are hardware and capital constraints. The inclusion of energy and carbon makes the physical footprint part of the same viability check as model performance, which matters because power and hardware limits, not just model quality, determine whether a project can run.

The record contains no results or benchmarks, only the list of estimators and their stated scope. Each tool shows its own arithmetic and states what it excludes, but the data does not say which projects pass or fail. It tells a reader which questions must be answered, not what the answers are.
